listing: This build also runs in other agents (agentseam loads_claude_plugins, seen in a live run):
warnings: Install one build per agent. If you install both the agent's own chock plugin and the Claude Code plugin, each one checks every action.
When another agent runs the Claude Code plugin, chock logs its events as claude_code (~/.chock/log/claude_code/), not under that agent.

steps.note: Plugins are off in grok until enabled: run `grok plugin list` for the id grok gave it, then `grok plugin enable <id>`.

steps.note: If `copilot plugin marketplace add` says Marketplace "__MARKETPLACE__" already registered, that is chock's Copilot build (this build's local marketplace is named __MARKETPLACE__; every chock build made with that name shares it): keep one build and run `copilot plugin marketplace remove __MARKETPLACE__` first.
It loads live from __PLUGIN_DIR__ (nothing is copied); `copilot plugin uninstall` only disables it.

steps.note: On Windows, `devin plugins install --local` creates a symbolic link, so it needs Developer Mode (Settings > System > For developers) or an elevated shell.

cursor.not_offered: Not offered for Cursor. With Include Third-Party Plugins on, Cursor imports an enabled Claude Code plugin and calls its hooks. But in the live test, chock never ran and nothing was refused. Do not rely on that import to enforce chock's policies.
